comparison.objective: Set and lock an angular-gripper stop versus install a case fan in a tool-less spring-latch bracket.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses two tools to preserve a screw setting during jam-nut tightening; fan installation requires square alignment through corner guides and axial pressing that deflects then releases two latches.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks repeated angular retention; fan success requires the released fan seated on the ring with both hooks returned over it and stable for one second.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot/compute hardware and final retention, but threaded calibration with counterholding differs from guided snap-fit insertion.
